question: The Erasmus+ budget for 2021-2027 amounts to EUR 26.2 billion – almost double of what is was for the previous period of 2014-2020 (EUR 14.7 billion). For 2028-2034, the Commission is proposing EUR 40.8 billion, while the European Parliament is discussing EUR 47.4 billion. The Erasmus+ budget therefore doubles every seven years. Yet, due to the shrinking population, the number of European students does not seem to be increasing at the same rate. It would even appear to be falling. So where is the money going?
